title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks and quality gating integration
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: CI did not run prompt-set regression checks consistently for merged model-serving changes, which allowed small prompt regressions to slip into production. This PR adds a lightweight CI hook that runs the eval-harness prompt-set regression checks as part of the default pipeline and wires a minimal quality gating rule that fails the CI on significant metric regressions.

Scope: - Add a containerized eval-harness runner for CI. - Integrate prompt-set regression checks (baseline vs candidate) with configurable thresholds. - Publish eval metrics as job artifacts and surface a simple pass/fail gating rule. - Add docs and a rollout plan for gradual opt-in across repos.

What changed (summary): - new CI job definition: .github/workflows/eval-regression.yml - eval-harness/ci/runner Dockerfile and entrypoint - eval-harness/ci/configs/default-regression-config.yaml (thresholds + prompt sets) - scripts/ci/publish-eval-artifact.sh - small refactor to eval-harness/core/runner to accept CI config and output JSON metrics - docs/dev/eval-harness-ci.md with enablement and troubleshooting steps

Checklist: [x] Add CI workflow and runner container [x] Implement gating logic and threshold config [x] Add artifact publishing for metrics [x] Add integration tests in CI smoke stage [x] Update docs and rollout notes

Testing: - Local: ran harness against current master baselines and synthetic regressions; ensured failure mode surfaces correctly. - CI: validated pipeline in forked repo (three runs) and in a staged branch; fixed flaky timeout in runner. - Perf: runtime for full prompt-set run ~45s on 4-vCPU container; added timeout/early-exit to keep CI within budget.

Rollout: default gating disabled for monorepo root; enabled for redwood/eval-harness and redwood/redwood-docs initially. Plan to enable gradually for other repos after 2 weeks of monitoring.

Notes: thresholds are conservative to avoid false positives; maintainers can opt a PR into strict gating by adding label 'eval-strict'.

Aisha Khan: Yes, thresholds live in eval-harness/ci/configs and we load per-repo overrides from .github/eval-config.yaml if present.
Priya Shah: Runner looks good but add a retry for transient network calls to the model registry (seen flaky in staging).
Aisha Khan: Added exponential backoff wrapper and a unit test that simulates transient failures.
Ethan Liu: CI runtime looks fine, but please add artifact retention notes and size limits to the workflow.
Aisha Khan: Workflow now uses upload-artifact with retention=30 and compresses metrics; noted limits in docs.
release_notes: Add CI integration for eval-harness prompt-set regression checks and a conservative quality gating rule. Admins can opt-in strict gating per-repo via .github/eval-config.yaml.
